jobs.details: IBPS opened online registration for the Common Recruitment Process for Regional Rural Banks (CRP RRBs XV) on 01.09.2026, closing on 21.09.2026, for Group "A" Officers (Scale-I, II & III) and Group "B" Office Assistants (Multipurpose). A candidate may apply for Office Assistants and for any one Officers post, but has to apply and pay separately for each. Officer Scale-I and Office Assistants take a Preliminary and a Main online examination; Officers Scale-II and Scale-III take a single online examination.
